prev.speaker: Max
prev.text: *I unroll my bedroll in the lee of a dune.*

next.speaker: DM Narrator
next.text: Three days of sand and wind later, the ruins finally rise out of the haze.

next.speaker: DM Narrator
next.text: Morning comes grey and cold. Luke is already awake, poking at the embers.

next.speaker: DM Narrator
next.text: The town gate creaks open onto the desert road, and the guild hall is far behind you.

next.speaker: DM Narrator
next.text:
* * *

The inner chamber is silent but for dripping water.

prev.speaker: Mae Hollis
prev.text: "Meet me at the docks at midnight."

next.speaker: Narrator
next.text: Midnight. Fog rolls off the water at the harbor docks, and Mae is already waiting by the crates.

next.speaker: Ponticius
next.text: "Right here, and I heard that." He shoulders through the crowd to the board.

prev.speaker: Max
prev.text: "What happened at the ruins last time?"

next.speaker: Arin
next.text: "Three years ago we went in with six. Two came back. The sphinx took the rest at the gate."

next.speaker: DM Narrator
next.text: Luke has crossed to the far side of the chamber, where a mural of the sun covers the wall.

prev.speaker: Max
prev.text: *I think about it for a long moment.*

next.speaker: Arin
next.text: "Take your time. Not like the sand's going anywhere."

next.speaker: Mae Hollis
next.text: "A cop I knew, back in '38. He asked too many questions too."
